answer.because: With unknown-options-as-args and halt-at-non-option both on, head parses ['--foo','./file.js','--bar'] as _:['./file.js'] with bar:true. Base gives _:['./file.js','--bar'], so on head the halt at the first positional never happens and the later flag is parsed as an option.

why: With unknown-options-as-args and halt-at-non-option both on, head parses ['--foo','./file.js','--bar'] as _:['./file.js'] with bar:true. Base gives _:['./file.js','--bar'], so on head the halt at the first positional never happens and the later flag is parsed as an option.
